_comment: Theme tokens. Copy to engine/remotion/src/data/theme.json (setup.sh does it once). Default = the repo palette: Field #F3EFE5 (light canvas), Ink #12141A (text, dark canvas), Cobalt #1D4AA5 (line: structure, routes, chart series), Slate #8195B0 (secondary, inactive, metadata), Beacon #EF681E (accent: the ONE thing that matters now, never a large fill). loss/danger red and ok green are semantic (money lost or a problem / success) and stay outside the palette on purpose.
